ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption defense-evasion chain: Safe Mode boot + VSS wipe + EDR service kill
ucs.description: Hunts the signature pre-ransom sequence Qilin/Agenda affiliates execute minutes before file encryption: setting Safe Mode via bcdedit (so AV/EDR drivers don't load on reboot), deleting Volume Shadow Copies, and stopping security services — all from a single elevated host. This chain is documented in Trend Micro and Sophos Qilin/Agenda IR reports and differentiates Qilin from RaaS crews that don't reboot into Safe Mode.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("bcdedit.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe") AND (Processes.process="*safeboot*" OR Processes.process="*shadows*delete*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR (Processes.process="*stop*" AND Processes.process IN ("*sense*","*WinDefend*","*MsMpSvc*","*MsSecFlt*","*Sophos*","*Sentinel*","*CrowdStrike*","*CSAgent*","*Carbon*","*MBAM*","*BackupExec*","*Veeam*","*VSS*","*SQL*")) OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*-Disable*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process_name) as ttp_bins values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(parent_process_name) as parents dc(process_name) as distinct_ttps by dest user | where distinct_ttps >= 3 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let Window = 30m;
let SafeBoot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("safeboot", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures", "recoveryenabled no");
let ShadowKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete", "shadows"))
       or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy", "delete"))
       or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete", "catalog"));
let EdrKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName in~ ("net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("sense","WinDefend","MsMpSvc","MsSecFlt","Sophos","Sentinel","CrowdStrike","CSAgent","CSFalcon","Carbon","MBAM","BackupExec","Veeam","VSS","MSSQL"))
       or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference -Disable","Uninstall-WindowsFeature Windows-Defender","Stop-Service -Force"));
SafeBoot
| project DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, SafeBootTime = Timestamp, SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| join kind=inner (
    ShadowKill | project DeviceId, ShadowTime = Timestamp, ShadowCmd = ProcessCommandLine
  ) on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SafeBootTime, ShadowTime)) <= 30
| join kind=inner (
    EdrKill | project DeviceId, EdrTime = Timestamp, EdrCmd = ProcessCommandLine
  ) on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SafeBootTime, EdrTime)) <= 30
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize Stage1_SafeBoot = any(SafeBootCmd),
            Stage2_ShadowWipe = any(ShadowCmd),
            Stage3_EdrKill = any(EdrCmd),
            FirstAction = min(SafeBootTime),
            LastAction = max(EdrTime)
            by DeviceName, AccountName
| order by LastAction desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let SafeBoot = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\bcdedit.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("safeboot", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures", "recoveryenabled no")
    | project Computer, Account=SubjectUserName, SafeBootTime=TimeGenerated, SafeBootCmd=CommandLine;
let ShadowKill = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
       or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
       or (NewProcessName endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
    | project Computer, ShadowTime=TimeGenerated, ShadowCmd=CommandLine;
let EdrKill = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName has_any ("\\net.exe","\\net1.exe","\\sc.exe","\\taskkill.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("sense","WinDefend","MsMpSvc","MsSecFlt","Sophos","Sentinel","CrowdStrike","CSAgent","CSFalcon","Carbon","MBAM","Veeam","MSSQL"))
       or (NewProcessName has_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("Set-MpPreference -Disable","Uninstall-WindowsFeature Windows-Defender"))
    | project Computer, EdrTime=TimeGenerated, EdrCmd=CommandLine;
SafeBoot
| join kind=inner ShadowKill on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SafeBootTime, ShadowTime)) <= 30
| join kind=inner EdrKill on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SafeBootTime, EdrTime)) <= 30
| where Account !endswith "$"
| summarize Stage1_SafeBoot=any(SafeBootCmd), Stage2_ShadowWipe=any(ShadowCmd), Stage3_EdrKill=any(EdrCmd),
            FirstAction=min(SafeBootTime), LastAction=max(EdrTime)
            by Computer, Account
| order by LastAction desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware Pre-Encryption Defense Evasion Chain
id: 9f5b7a2c-3e8d-4f1b-9a6c-2a1d4e8f3b5e
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit Safe Mode flag, VSS wipe, or service kill commands characteristic of Qilin/Agenda ransomware pre-encryption staging.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/11
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/h/agenda-qilin-ransomware-rust.html
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1489
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  safe_boot:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
  shadow_wipe_vssadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  shadow_wipe_wmic:
    Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  shadow_wipe_wbadmin:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  edr_kill:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\net.exe'
      - '\net1.exe'
      - '\sc.exe'
      - '\taskkill.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'sense'
      - 'WinDefend'
      - 'Sophos'
      - 'Sentinel'
      - 'CSFalcon'
      - 'CSAgent'
      - 'CrowdStrike'
      - 'Veeam'
      - 'MSSQL'
  condition: safe_boot or shadow_wipe_vssadmin or shadow_wipe_wmic or shadow_wipe_wbadmin or edr_kill
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate sysadmin backup or recovery testing (rare on production endpoints)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot* OR *SafeBoot* OR *SAFEBOOT* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"recoveryenabled no"*)) OR (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"*)) OR (@Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy*delete* OR *ShadowCopy*Delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBAdmin.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"Delete Catalog"*)) OR (@Image:(*\net.exe OR *\net1.exe OR *\sc.exe OR *\taskkill.exe OR *\Net.exe OR *\SC.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*sense* OR *WinDefend* OR *Sophos* OR *Sentinel* OR *CrowdStrike* OR *CSFalcon* OR *CSAgent* OR *Carbon* OR *Veeam* OR *MSSQL*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/safeboot|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|recoveryenabled\s+no/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND regex("shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(net1?|sc|taskkill)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/sense|WinDefend|MsMpSvc|MsSecFlt|Sophos|Sentinel|CrowdStrike|CSFalcon|CSAgent|Carbon|Veeam|MSSQL/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/Set-MpPreference\s+-Disable|Uninstall-WindowsFeature\s+Windows-Defender/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine]), count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=distinct_ttps), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen) })
| distinct_ttps >= 3
ucs.rationale: Generic ransomware detections fire on any shadow-copy wipe, generating noise. Qilin/Agenda is one of the few RaaS crews that adds a Safe Mode reboot stage (bcdedit /set safeboot network) BEFORE the shadow wipe so EDR drivers don't load post-reboot — documented in Trend Micro's 2024 Agenda Rust analysis and multiple Sophos/Group-IB IR reports. Requiring ≥3 of {SafeBoot, ShadowWipe, EdrKill} on one

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin Chrome credential harvesting via SYSVOL/GPO-pushed PowerShell logon script
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's distinctive Aug-2024 TTP (Sophos X-Ops): after compromising a domain controller, affiliates pushed a malicious PowerShell logon script via Group Policy from \\<domain>\SYSVOL\<domain>\scripts\ that ran on every workstation logon, copying Chrome's Login Data SQLite DB and Local State (containing the AES master key) to a staging share. This GPO-fanout credential-theft pattern is rare outside Qilin and differentiates them from standard pre-ransom looting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("userinit.exe","explorer.exe","gpscript.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*\\\\*\\SYSVOL\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\\\*\\NETLOGON\\*" OR Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Local State*" OR Processes.process="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename dest as host | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let GpoScriptLaunch = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("userinit.exe","gpscript.exe","explorer.exe","services.exe")
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\\\[^\\]+\\(SYSVOL|NETLOGON)\\"
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data", "Login Data", "Local State", "os_crypt", "encrypted_key")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentProcess = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProcess = FileName;
let ChromeFileTouch = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FolderPath has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\"))
         or FileName in~ ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","esentutl.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe")
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, AccessedFile = strcat(FolderPath, FileName),
              FileInitiatorCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
GpoScriptLaunch
| join kind=inner ChromeFileTouch on DeviceId
| where FileTime between (Timestamp .. Timestamp + 5m)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentProcess, ChildProcess, ChildCmd, AccessedFile, FileInitiatorCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("\\userinit.exe","\\gpscript.exe","\\explorer.exe","\\services.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\wscript.exe","\\cscript.exe")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\\\[^\\]+\\(SYSVOL|NETLOGON)\\"
     or CommandLine has_any (@"\Google\Chrome\User Data", @"\Microsoft\Edge\User Data", "Login Data", "Local State", "os_crypt", "encrypted_key")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account=SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcess=ParentProcessName,
          ChildProcess=NewProcessName,
          ChildCmd=CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin Ransomware Chrome Credential Theft via GPO Logon Script
id: 2b4c8e1f-7d3a-4e9c-b8f5-6c2d9a3f1e7b
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell/cmd logon scripts launched from SYSVOL or NETLOGON shares that target Chrome/Edge credential stores — the TTP Sophos attributed to Qilin in August 2024.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/11
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1037.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_logon_script:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\userinit.exe'
      - '\gpscript.exe'
      - '\services.exe'
  child_interpreter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  cmdline_sysvol:
    CommandLine|re: '(?i)\\\\[^\\]+\\(SYSVOL|NETLOGON)\\'
  cmdline_chrome:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - '\Microsoft\Edge\User Data'
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Local State'
      - 'os_crypt'
      - 'encrypted_key'
  condition: parent_logon_script and child_interpreter and (cmdline_sysvol or cmdline_chrome)
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate enterprise logon scripts that enumerate user profile paths (rare for Chrome paths specifically)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\userinit.exe OR *\UserInit.exe OR *\gpscript.exe OR *\GPScript.exe OR *\services.exe OR *\Services.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\Cmd.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe) @CommandLine:(*\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\sysvol\\* OR *\\NETLOGON\\* OR *\\netlogon\\* OR *"\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data"* OR *"\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data"* OR *"Login Data"* OR *"Local State"* OR *os_crypt* OR *encrypted_key*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(userinit|gpscript|services)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(SYSVOL|NETLOGON)\\\\", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
  OR CommandLine=/\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data|\\Microsoft\\Edge\\User Data|Login\s+Data|Local\s+State|os_crypt|encrypted_key/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function={ collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), count() })
ucs.rationale: Most ransomware crews loot a handful of admin endpoints. Qilin (Aug 2024 Sophos X-Ops report) uniquely deployed a Group Policy logon-script fanout to harvest Chrome credentials from EVERY domain workstation — a noisy, opportunistic credential-access pattern that no other major RaaS uses at scale. Pinning the detection on userinit.exe/gpscript.exe → PowerShell → SYSVOL path + Chrome credential-stor
